rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a medicine or medicinal application that treats an illness.

example.english: This remedy is very effective; take it for a few days and the fever will go down.
example.traditional: 呢隻藥好有效，食幾日就退燒。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 joek6 hou2 jau5 haau6 sik6 gei2 jat6 zau6 teoi3 siu1

rows.note: Use this when “remedy” means the treatment or course of care rather than the medicine itself.

example.english: This remedy requires a full three months of treatment, so you can't give up halfway.
example.traditional: 呢個治療要做足三個月，唔可以半途而廢。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zi6 liu4 jiu3 zou6 zuk1 saam1 go3 jyut6 m4 ho2 ji5 bun3 tou4 ji4 fai3
